description: This Dart file defines the AttendanceProvider class, which manages and coordinates the UI state for student attendance tracking in a Flutter application. It provides methods for marking attendance, loading daily and weekly attendance reports, auto-refresh via polling, and offline synchronization. It interacts with an external AttendanceRepository for data operations.

classes.name: AttendanceProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages attendance UI state, including marking attendance, fetching reports, auto-refresh, and sync management.

methods.name: markNow
methods.description: Marks attendance for a student at the current time, then refreshes daily and weekly data.

methods.name: loadDaily
methods.description: Fetches daily attendance data for a specific date.

methods.name: loadWeekly
methods.description: Fetches weekly attendance data starting from a specific week start date.

methods.name: startAutoRefresh
methods.description: Begins periodic polling to refresh data and sync offline changes.

methods.name: syncPending
methods.description: Attempts to synchronize offline pending data with the backend.
